en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: As for the one who thinks that the situation is confusing to him

and he does not know whether Imam Hasan Askari (a.s) did have a son or not, and that he will adhere to the Imamate of Imam Hasan Askari (a.s) until it is proved that he had a son, his assertion is invalid, because we proved the Imamate of Ibn Hasan (a.s) and we proved that the Imams are twelve.

Retaining these proofs in mind, one need not be confused, but rather, it is most convincing that Hasan’s son is the Imam. It is further strengthened by our proofs that no Imam passes away until he sires an heir and sees his legatee.
